name: ps5-hardware-control
description: Decky Loader plugin for PS5 fan, CPU/GPU governor and LED control on Linux

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -rf out && mkdir -p out/ps5-hardware-control && cp -R plugin.json package.json main.py README.md LICENSE dist out/ps5-hardware-control/ && cd out && zip -qr ps5-hwcon-plugin.zip ps5-hardware-control -x '*.DS_Store'
